about: has_word: word occurs in x, ordinal and case-sensitive, with no word character on either side (§ 3.5.3).

cases.about: § 3.5.3 has_word: a letter after the word is a word character, so painful is not pain.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: a letter before the word is a word character, so Spain is not pain.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: punctuation is not a word character.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: the word may contain a space.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: _ is connector punctuation, a word character.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: a decimal digit is a word character.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: a later occurrence with boundaries is found.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: an accented letter is a word character, but the second occurrence stands alone.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: the letter U+1D4B3 outside the Basic Multilingual Plane is a word character.
§ 3.5.3 has_word: an emoji is not a word character.
§ 3.6.2 has_word: a number, data that escaped validation, reads as null, so false.
